policy_citations.passage:
Response deadline
If the merchant sends the response after the response deadline, the merchant loses the dispute automatically, without a review of the merits. A receipt timestamp alone does not establish when the merchant sent the response. The response deadline is the deadline of Acme for the response of the merchant: it shows up in the dispute's deadline field, ten to fourteen days after the dispute is opened, and it is a house rule of Acme and not the deadline of the card network. The Acme Payments internal cutoff for sending evidence is one business day before the response deadline. The card network has a separate, longer window of thirty calendar days for the categories of Visa and the frames of Mastercard (source: the Visa Core Rules and the Mastercard Chargeback Guide, read on 2026-11-25).
